name: EPI T1 Registration
summary: Registers DWI to a T1-weighted image with FSL epi_reg and flirt using the mean b0, optionally reslices it with DIPY, rotates the bvecs and outputs the aligned DWI and affine.
description: Averages the b0 volumes, skull-strips them with bet, registers them to the T1 (optionally skull-stripped with bet first) using epi_reg, applies the transform to the whole DWI with flirt, optionally reslices to an isotropic resolution and rotates the bvecs. Use it to bring DWI into T1/ACPC space before tractography. The README also mentions tensor fitting and a dt6.mat, which this branch's code does not produce.

inputs.description: The path to the DWI datatype
The path to the anat/t1w datatype

outputs.description: Affine transform from DWI to T1 space (affine.txt, FSL flirt matrix).

parameters.description: The isotropic resolution to reslice the data. If you want to leave the DWI in the native DWI space, leave this empty
If true, skull-strip the T1 with FSL bet before registration.

citations.text: Jenkinson M, Smith SM. A global optimisation method for robust affine registration of brain images. Medical Image Analysis 5(2):143-156 (2001).
Jenkinson M, Bannister PR, Brady JM, Smith SM. Improved optimisation for the robust and accurate linear registration and motion correction of brain images. NeuroImage 17(2):825-841 (2002).

failure_modes.fix: Check the log for epi_reg or flirt errors; the aligned dwi.nii.gz was not produced.
